title: King Oliver dropping a brick to signal the band to stop
summary: Dawson explains Oliver threw a brick on the music stand to cut off players who ran past the knock-off; the hall was uptown, name forgotten.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline
